data.name: Atheel
data.gender_notes: Atheel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is given a gift or talent from Allah, endowed with wisdom and intelligence. The name Atheel carries the meaning “Gifted, Intelligent, Wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Atheel usually hope their child will grow to embody gifted, intelligent, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a boy who is believed to be blessed with divine wisdom and knowledge.
data.etymology: Atheel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gifted, Intelligent, Wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atheel total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: عطيل
in_arabic.meaning: عطيل يعني الشخص ذو المكانة الرفيعة والمنزلة العالية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عطيل مشتق من الجذر العربي (ع-ط-ل) الذي يعني الارتفاع والعلو. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى الشخص ذو المكانة الرفيعة والمنزلة العالية في المجتمع. كما أنه يوحي بالشرف والكرامة. وقد ورد هذا الاسم في بعض الأحاديث النبوية، مما يضيف له قيمة دينية وروحية.

in_urdu.name: عطیل
in_urdu.meaning: عطیل مطلب ہے بلند مقام والا اور اچھے اخلاق والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عطیل نام عربی جڑ (ع-ط-ل) سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بلند اور اعلیٰ۔ اردو میں، یہ نام اچھے اخلاق والا اور بلند مقام رکھنے والے شخص کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے ثقافتی سیاق میں، یہ نام فرد کی عزت، شان اور روحانی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अथील
in_hindi.meaning: अथील का अर्थ है उच्च स्थान वाला और अच्छे आचरण वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: अथील नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल (ع-ط-ل) से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है उच्च और उत्कृष्ट। हिंदी में, यह नाम उच्च नैतिक मानकों और अच्छे आचरण वाले व्यक्ति को संदर्भित करता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम व्यक्ति की गरिमा, सम्मान और आध्यात्मिक महत्व को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: عطیل
in_pashto.meaning: عطیل د لوړ مقام لرونکی او ښه اخلاق لرونکی معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: عطیل نوم د عربی جڑ (ع-ط-ل) څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې لوړ او اعلیٰ دی. په پښتو کې، دا نوم د لوړ مقام لرونکی او ښه اخلاق لرونکی سړي لپاره کارول کیږي. د افغان او پښتني دودیزو ارزښتونو له مخې، دا نوم د سړي د عزت، وقار او روحاني ارزښت څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Atheel
in_english.meaning: Atheel means noble, exalted, and high in status
in_english.long_meaning: The name Atheel originates from the Arabic root (ع-ط-ل), meaning 'to rise' or 'to be elevated'. In Islamic tradition, Atheel signifies a person of high moral character, nobility, and elevated social status. The name is associated with virtues such as honor, dignity, and spiritual excellence. Historically, Atheel has been used in various Muslim cultures to denote individuals of respect and distinction.

In many cultural traditions within Islamic communities, the naming of a child is considered a sacred act, and a name like Atheel conveys the idea that one is bestowed with unique qualities and abilities that contribute to society as a whole.

It is a reminder that each person has a role to play in the world and that their talents and gifts are essential to fulfilling that role. This name serves as a constant reminder to seek Allah's guidance and to use the gifts and talents that have been bestowed upon us for the greater good.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Atheel means "strong, firm, and unyielding." It symbolizes a person with a steadfast and unwavering spirit, who remains grounded and unwavering in their beliefs and convictions. This name is a source of inspiration for those seeking inner strength and resilience in the face of adversity.

historical_references.context: Ibn Khaldun's influential work details the history and social dynamics of the Islamic world, providing insight into the lives of various leaders, including Atheel.

historical_references.reference: Al-Maqrizi's 'The History of the Prophets and Kings' recounts Atheel, a Berber king of the Banu Ganfida who ruled over the Maghreb in the late 11th century.
